title: Pin M5 composition refusal checks to intended statuses and reasons
outcome: Ensure composition negative controls distinguish stale authority or unavailable transport from missing reference rows and unrelated failures.
acceptance: Recreation, authority changes, lost-reply, outage and post-reload reference resolve checks assert the intended status/reason; after reload a wrongly missing published handle (404) cannot satisfy an expected stale-authority refusal (409).
Relevant actual MCP send refusals retain meaningful reason checks where available; focused tests pass without weakening existing negative controls.
